verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly touches transcription: HIPAA docs mention 'approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers' implying multiple STT providers exist, and pronunciation dictionaries let you customize how terms are spoken (not necessarily transcribed). There is no dedicated documentation on selecting/configuring STT providers, tuning models, or boosting key terms for transcription accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit STT provider selection/config docs, transcription accuracy/keyword-boosting features, and independent evidence of real-time transcription quality.
